A Chinese leaker with a decent track record has posted what are claimed to be schematics for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro models.

The images suggest the new A20 Pro chip may feature seven GPU cores — one more than the previous generation — along with a faster memory interface...

The images, posted by Weibo user "Fixed Focus Digital," are not of the A20 Pro chip itself, but rather diagrams showing where the chip will be soldered onto the underlying circuit board. From these, they have inferred the new chip's performance and architecture, drawing two main conclusions that they believe represent possible improvements.

First, the images show the CPU core configuration is the same as last year — six cores: two high-performance cores and four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to have more cache memory.

It is difficult to determine the GPU core count from the limited information provided by solder point diagrams alone, with six, seven, or even eight cores all being possible options. However, they ultimately concluded that seven cores is the most likely scenario.

"Fixed Focus Digital" previously also indicated that the A20 Pro chip would be 18% faster than its predecessor, with a 30% improvement in power efficiency.

9to5Mac's take

While this Weibo account does carry some credibility, this method of indirect inference is quite demanding. Although their conclusions may appear reasonable, readers should not take them as fact — at most, they can be regarded as well-informed speculation.
